asr.full_text: Hello, you in Kryptomir channel. The channel dedicated to the electronic currencies, ICO's, Bounty companies, and news in the world of cryptocurrencies. Today we will talk about the PolybiusBank project. PolybiusBank is an innovative project, fully digital bank, which also a safe service for banks, which makes the use of banking products more convenient. Actually, it saves time and becomes a comfortable solution for the emerging market of electronic commerce. Polybius' task is to bring interdisciples of finance network to the Internet. Not only the financial service, Polybius bank will create an electronic identification system with a physical EID card. It will provide a qualitative service services in each European country. Let us now look at the stages of this project creation. To begin with, Polybius is an automated payment institution. and for the financial institutions that purchase all the devices using EMI. To obtain this program, you will need hearing service, membership in Swiss, IPI license and a possibility to issue a loan. The first stage of this program costs 1.5 million US dollars. When applying to the second part of the program, Pallibius is planning to collect 3 million million to acquire the status of electrical money user. The project will be aimed at of Polybius PI . Bank may also publish its own cards as a member of the payment system Visa, MasterCard and others. and also present other banking products. At the forth stage of Polybius plan to collect $10 mln Polybius Foundation will be able to focus on digital PaaS design on aggregate system for suppliers, customers and private citizens that will enable to confirm the identity, to keep and process personal data. At stage 5, that is 25$, Polybius Bank can improve the payment service, get to greater ROI by credit, will provide services outside of EU, they are presented by large teams of investors into a good game. These services will be a reliable platform for crowdfunding. There is also a sixth stage, We will provide $ 50 million for business and $ 100 million for insurance and brokerage services. We have collected more than $ 27.5 million this project has many evidences to make its success. There are plenty of ground for think that this is a very successful token. Let's focus on ICO company. ICO means that it is a primary token distribution organization. The project was launched by Bitcoin Talk and is created by Bitcoin Talk. Here you see the partners' rewards for those tokens that win, as well as the 93 percent of the opening sales of the company. These rewards are distributed as follows. By the way, the Bitcoin Talk app gives 10% of the new and updated payments to Bitcoin Talk, 10% of Facebook and Twitter rating. The Polybius branch gives 10% and 4 experienced, many of whom have confirmed the success of a project. So please join us, everyone is waiting for your success. Stay tuned. We are CryptoMir, see you around. Bye!

textual.observation: The presentation claims the PolybiusBank token project can achieve greater ROI, describes the token as successful, and invites viewers to join.

evidence.quote: get to greater ROI by credit
There are plenty of ground for think that this is a very successful token.
So please join us, everyone is waiting for your success.

textual.context: Promotional project-presentation context is supported by the direct invitation to join; the records do not clarify what joining requires.
textual.potential_relevance: A financial-return and token-success claim is paired with a direct request to join, linking a promised outcome to audience participation.
textual.limitations: No payment amount, timeframe, guarantee, eligibility condition, or verified return is established; the ASR may contain recognition errors.

textual.observation: The presentation describes partner rewards and percentage allocations tied to token opening sales and named platform activities, including 93% and 10% figures.

evidence.quote: Here you see the partners' rewards for those tokens that win, as well as the 93 percent of the opening sales of the company.
By the way, the Bitcoin Talk app gives 10% of the new and updated payments to Bitcoin Talk, 10% of Facebook and Twitter rating.
The Polybius branch gives 10% and 4 experienced, many of whom have confirmed the success of a project.

textual.context: Presented as part of the ICO explanation; the ASR wording leaves some role assignments and percentage meanings unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: Percentage-based rewards or proceeds are connected to token sales and platform activity, creating a reward structure that may require later review of what participation or promotion is being requested.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish who pays whom, what 'tokens that win' means, whether viewers are asked to perform the stated activities, or whether the figures are accurate.

visual.observation: A page labeled "ДОРОЖНАЯ КАРТА" presents staged funding amounts of $1,500,000, $3,000,000, $6,000,000, $10,000,000 and $25,000,000+, and states that if the project does not raise the required amount, "мы полностью вернем все полученные средства".
visual.context: Promotional project roadmap for Polybius Bank; the statement is presented as a conditional return-of-funds claim tied to reaching a funding target.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised return of received funds is explicitly linked to participation in a staged funding campaign and the condition of failing to reach the stated target.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show how funds are submitted, who receives them, whether the stated return occurred, or whether the project or claim is genuine.

visual.observation: An ICO page displays a bonus schedule of +25% on day 1, +20% during days 2-7, then decreasing weekly percentages through week 5, alongside a token distribution diagram showing an open sale.
visual.context: The material is presented as ICO promotional content; the frames do not clearly show the exact action required to obtain each bonus.
visual.potential_relevance: Time-limited percentage bonuses are presented in connection with an open token sale, creating a reward claim linked to an investment-related purchase condition.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the token's value, the applicable purchase terms, whether the bonuses were available, or any resulting financial outcome.

visual.observation: A section titled "Специальное предложение" states that investing a minimum of $1,000 will provide an additional 25% bonus and directs viewers to contact "[EMAIL]" for participation details.
visual.context: The offer appears in promotional material for Polybius Bank and is framed as an exclusive presale offer.
visual.potential_relevance: A specified monetary investment and contact action are directly linked to a promised additional 25% bonus.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show payment instructions, recipient details, eligibility beyond the minimum investment, verification of the email address, or whether any bonus was delivered.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source frames the content as a cryptocurrency-channel project presentation and explicitly shifts to an ICO discussion.

evidence.quote: Today we will talk about the PolybiusBank project.

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled pages consistently present Polybius as a bank or financial-technology project and include ICO, token, funding, and investment promotional sections.
A separate page displays claimed investment totals of 10660.246231 BTC and 27,529,555 USD under the heading "ИНВЕСТИРОВАНО".

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it directly promotes participation in the Polybius ICO, describes the token as likely to be successful, and ends by urging viewers to join. It combines that success assurance with a public token sale, staged investment targets, and time-based bonus-token incentives, encouraging viewers to purchase the promoted token rather than neutrally explaining the project.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the video promotes purchasing an ICO token through an open sale and ties participation to expected token success and bonus allocations. The evidence shows an explicit participation pathway and promotional return-oriented framing, rather than merely discussing cryptocurrency markets.

evidence.observation: The speaker presents the promoted Polybius token as likely to be successful while discussing the ICO.
evidence.quote: There are plenty of ground for think that this is a very successful token.

evidence.observation: The speaker gives a direct call to participate in the promoted project.
evidence.quote: So please join us, everyone is waiting for your success.

evidence.observation: The displayed ICO structure shows 93% allocated to an open sale and a schedule of token bonuses declining from +25% on day 1 to +0% in week 5, providing a purchase incentive.
The displayed special presale offer states that investing at least 10,000 USD in the ICO provides an additional 25% of tokens.
